P8028.corridor_notes: Part of 广东省输气管网一期管道工程 (Guangdong Province Phase 1 gas pipeline project, ~448km total): three trunk lines (鳌头-广州, 广州-肇庆, 广州-惠州) plus three branch lines (韶关支干线, 清远支干线/Qingyuan branch, 东莞支干线/Dongguan branch). This PID = the Qingyuan branch, Qingyuan section. Existence of the 清远支干线 as a named branch of the network is confirmed by antpedia.com; the full-project completion/acceptance survey report (350pp, doc88.com) is the presumed underlying primary source for GEM's existing StartLocation=Shijiao Town / EndLocation=Qingcheng District but is paywalled (800-credit download) so its endpoint text could not be read directly this session.
P8028.researcher_notes: GEM's PipelineName cell for this row contains an embedded trailing \r control character ("Guangdong Pearl River Delta gas pipeline network\r") — confirmed when matching payload JSON; stripped for matching, flagging the data-entry defect per task instructions. Separately, bjx.com.cn (2023, 2025) confirms a 清远市石角天然气分布式能源站 (Shijiao gas distributed-energy station) is active in 石角工业园 — consistent with gas supply reaching Shijiao, but that article's content could not be read in clear text (obfuscated page) so it isn't cited as a ref.
P8028.blockers: Could not find an independent, readable primary source (news/EIA) that states Shijiao Town and Qingcheng District specifically as this branch's endpoints — only that the branch exists as part of the larger network. Search was heavily constrained this session: the WebSearch tool hit its session-wide 200-query cap early (shared across parallel batch agents), and Baidu/Bing/Sogou/DuckDuckGo/Ecosia web search UIs all blocked or CAPTCHA'd scripted access via curl/WebFetch; so.toutiao.com and weixin.sogou.com worked intermittently and were the main workaround. Coordinates given are geocoded from the GEM-recorded place names themselves (town/district centroids), not independently corroborated.

P8029.corridor_notes: Part of 广东省输气管网一期管道工程 (Guangdong Province Phase 1 gas pipeline project, ~448km total, same parent project as P8028) — this PID = the Dongguan branch (东莞支干线). P8029.researcher_notes: GEM's PipelineName cell for this row contains embedded trailing \r\n control characters ("Guangdong Pearl River Delta gas pipeline network\r\n") — confirmed when matching payload JSON; stripped for matching, flagging the data-entry defect per task instructions. 'Tonghu Town' (GEM StartLocation) could NOT be confidently identified/geocoded: no administrative town of that name exists in Dongguan. The phonetically closest OSM match, 潼湖镇 (Tonghu Town, lon 114.1915569 lat 23.0852030), is in Huicheng District, Huizhou — not Dongguan — which is inconsistent with the 'Dongguan Branch' segment name and the network's Guangzhou-Huizhou trunk line already covering the Huizhou side separately, so it was deliberately NOT used as a guess. This needs a human/researcher with access to the paywalled doc88.com acceptance report (or Chinese-source lookup tools not available this session) to resolve.
P8029.blockers: Same session-wide search-tool constraints as P8028 (WebSearch budget exhausted; major search engines blocked scripted access). Additionally 'Tonghu Town' itself is unresolved/ambiguous — left ungeocoded rather than guessed at the wrong city. Zhangmutou (樟木头镇, Dongguan) geocoded confidently from the GEM-recorded name but without an endpoint-specific corroborating ref.

P5052.corridor_notes: 榆林至西安输气管道工程一期起于宜川压气站，止于西安临潼分输站，全长约277.66公里；目前项目正在加快开展施工前手续办理工作 (Q3 2025). Length matches GEM's LengthMergedKm (277.66) exactly.
P5052.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT DATA FLAG: GEM's StartLocation field for this row reads "Yuheng", but the sourced material (163.com, citing the operating company's investor-relations response) gives the start as 宜川压气站 (Yichuan Compressor Station, Yichuan County, Yan'an). The exact length match (277.66km, to two decimals) confirms this is unambiguously the same pipeline GEM is tracking, so "Yuheng" appears to be a transliteration/data-entry error for "Yichuan" (宜川) — recommend GEM's StartLocation be corrected to Yichuan/宜川压气站 on review.

P7765.corridor_notes: 安旬天然气长输管线项目：起点安康，终点旬阳，途经汉滨区、旬阳、高新区。项目2016年曾获批但搁置，2020年11月正式重启前期工作；截至2023年2月仍处于协调阶段，已列入《陕西省石油天然气“十四五”发展规划》，陕天然气股份公司与旬阳市政府正就下游燃气经营市场收购事宜磋商，尚未开工建设。 (Consistent with GEM Status_sheet = proposed.)
P7765.researcher_notes: Two Ankang municipal-government sources (2021 proposal response, 2023 people's congress reply) corroborate the corridor at city/county granularity, matching GEM's own StartLocation=Ankang / EndLocation=Xunyang exactly. Used Hanbin District (Ankang's urban core) for the start point since the 2021 source explicitly names it as the first corridor county.

P7609.corridor_notes: 威海高压天然气管线一期工程：以国家管网集团泰青威管道威海分输站为起点，途经临港区汪疃镇、文登区米山镇、宋村镇，至线路终点宋村分输站；规划高压天然气长输管线37公里+市政高压天然气管线9公里。截至2024年6月，地文头至汪疃分输站(3.65km)及汪疃至威海港华燃气市政段(3.25km)已建成通气，汪疃至宋村段预计年底前完成。GEM段名 'Weihai High Pressure Gas Pipeline' (Wangtong Town→Songcun) 对应汪疃至宋村段，与工程规划长输管线37km总长一致（GEM LengthMergedKm=37.00）。
P7609.researcher_notes: Qilu Network (齐鲁网, Shandong provincial state media) article gives the full corridor with all station names and exact segment lengths; the 37km trunk length matches GEM's LengthMergedKm (37.00) exactly, confirming this PID = the 汪疃至宋村 (Wangtuan-to-Songcun) leg of the larger Weihai high-pressure pipeline Phase 1 project (whose true overall corridor start is further upstream at 威海分输站/Weihai Distribution Station on the PipeChina Taiqingwei trunk line). GEM's 'Wangtong Town' appears to be a transliteration variant of 汪疃镇 (Wangtuan Town) — flagging for spelling-standardization review, not a location error. As of the June 2024 source, the Wangtuan–Songcun section itself was still targeted for year-end 2024 completion; GEM's Status_sheet='operating' implies it was completed on schedule, but no later confirming article was found this session (see blockers).
P7609.blockers: No source postdating June 2024 was found to directly confirm completion/gas-flow specifically on the Wangtuan–Songcun leg (vs. the already-confirmed Diwentou–Wangtuan leg) — endpoint identity and route are solidly confirmed, but the operating-status timing relies on GEM's own Status_sheet value rather than an independent post-completion source.
